deviations.what: h8/c8 say the gateway relays rerank/score bodies BYTE-identical; measured in t5, handle_post always runs rewrite_model() which json.loads/json.dumps the body even when model already equals the served name, so the wire bytes are re-encoded (whitespace) while every field — instruction included — is semantically unmodified. t5's tests pin the true behaviour (content equality + explicit re-encoding proof) instead of a false byte-identical assertion; server.py untouched.
deviations.reason: The boundary's substantive intent (never inject/rewrite/default instruction) holds; the honesty condition's wording over-specified the wire. Fixing the gateway to relay raw bytes is a production change outside this frame's scope.
